Why Muhammad is a messenger

Sent as mercy

The Quran gives one reason for his sending: mercy to all the worlds.

What was he for? The Quran answers in a single line: he was sent only as a mercy to all the worlds. It describes him as pained by what burdens people and eager for their good. It says God's mercy made him gentle, and that harshness would have scattered those around him. It tells him to pardon them, seek forgiveness for them, and consult them. His whole mission, stated as mercy.

﴿وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.

Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:107

﴿لَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُم بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is what you suffer; [he is] concerned over you [i.e., your guidance] and to the believers is kind and merciful.

Quran · At-Tawbah 9:128

﴿فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لِنتَ لَهُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ كُنتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ ٱلْقَلْبِ لَٱنفَضُّوا۟ مِنْ حَوْلِكَ ۖ فَٱعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

So by mercy from Allāh, [O Muḥammad], you were lenient with them. And if you had been rude [in speech] and harsh in heart, they would have disbanded from about you. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter. And when you have decided, then rely upon Allāh. Indeed, Allāh loves those who rely [upon Him].

Quran · Aal Imran 3:159

You might ask

QuestionMercy? He fought wars.
AnswerHe did. One verse permits fighting those who fight you and forbids going beyond it. Other verses and events are harder. They deserve an honest reading, and the questions below give one.Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:190
QuestionMercy for Muslims, or for everyone?
AnswerThe verse says all the worlds, and another says he was sent to all people. No one stands outside the address.Quran · Saba 34:28
QuestionHow can a warning be mercy?
AnswerSomeone who warns you of danger ahead has not stopped caring. In the Quran warning and good news travel together.Quran · Al-A'raf 7:188

His mission comes down to one word: mercy.
